speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I see you have a history of gait and limb ataxia; to understand the underlying cause, can you describe exactly how your balance and coordination have been affected?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned clumsiness on the right side; do you also notice any weakness or numbness in your arms and legs, and have you experienced any vision changes or double vision?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: PML (Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

I need to confirm your current neurological status and review imaging. Have you noticed any worsening of your symptoms over the past few weeks, such as increased clumsiness or vision loss? REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain_WITH_CONTRAST; REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_Brain.
